-- Schema for database: rschema_0506

CREATE TABLE `construction_management_unit` (
  `unit_id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `unit_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `contact_number` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `responsible_person` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `associated_project` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `annual_plan` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `supervision_department_id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`unit_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `construction_management_unit_ibfk_supervision_department_id` FOREIGN KEY (`supervision_department_id`) REFERENCES `collaborative_task` (`supervision_department_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `business_project_department_progress` (
  `project_department_id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `department_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `responsible_person` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `project_progress` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `issue_reporting` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`project_department_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `resource_allocation` (
  `resource_id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `project_id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `allocation_status` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `usage_record` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`resource_id`, `project_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `resource_allocation_ibfk_resource_id` FOREIGN KEY (`resource_id`) REFERENCES `resource_table` (`resource_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `resource_allocation_ibfk_project_id` FOREIGN KEY (`project_id`) REFERENCES `supervision_project_department` (`project_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `collaborative_task` (
  `task_id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `project_id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `task_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `responsible_person` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `task_progress` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `task_priority` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`task_id`, `project_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `collaborative_task_ibfk_task_id` FOREIGN KEY (`task_id`) REFERENCES `collaborative_work_platform` (`task_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `collaborative_task_ibfk_project_id` FOREIGN KEY (`project_id`) REFERENCES `supervision_project_department` (`project_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `supervision_project_department` (
  `supervision_department_id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `supervision_department_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `responsible_person` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `resource_allocation` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `personnel_management` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`supervision_department_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `electrical_grid_infrastructure_project` (
  `project_id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `project_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `construction_progress` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `resource_allocation` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `quality_control` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `safety_management` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `project_department_id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `unit_id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `task_id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`project_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `electrical_grid_infrastructure_project_ibfk_task_id` FOREIGN KEY (`task_id`) REFERENCES `collaborative_work_platform` (`task_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `electrical_grid_infrastructure_project_ibfk_unit_id` FOREIGN KEY (`unit_id`) REFERENCES `construction_management_unit` (`unit_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `electrical_grid_infrastructure_project_ibfk_project_department_id` FOREIGN KEY (`project_department_id`) REFERENCES `business_project_department_progress` (`project_department_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `resource_table` (
  `resource_id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `resource_type` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `resource_quantity` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`resource_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `collaborative_work_platform` (
  `task_id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `task_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `responsible_person` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `task_progress` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `task_priority` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `completion_status` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`task_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `project_management` (
  `project_id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `unit_id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `project_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `construction_progress` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `resource_allocation` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `quality_control` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `safety_management` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`project_id`, `unit_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `project_management_ibfk_unit_id` FOREIGN KEY (`unit_id`) REFERENCES `construction_management_unit` (`unit_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `project_management_ibfk_project_id` FOREIGN KEY (`project_id`) REFERENCES `supervision_project_department` (`project_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `project_department_management` (
  `project_department_id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `project_id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `project_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `project_progress` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `issue_reporting` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`project_department_id`, `project_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `project_department_management_ibfk_project_id` FOREIGN KEY (`project_id`) REFERENCES `supervision_project_department` (`project_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `project_department_management_ibfk_project_department_id` FOREIGN KEY (`project_department_id`) REFERENCES `business_project_department_progress` (`project_department_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `supervision_department_management` (
  `supervision_department_id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `project_id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `project_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `resource_allocation` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `personnel_management` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`supervision_department_id`, `project_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `supervision_department_management_ibfk_supervision_department_id` FOREIGN KEY (`supervision_department_id`) REFERENCES `collaborative_task` (`supervision_department_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `supervision_department_management_ibfk_project_id` FOREIGN KEY (`project_id`) REFERENCES `supervision_project_department` (`project_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

Business Requirements Description:
1.Construction Management Unit Module:Login to the construction management system, select individual projects, create projects and route sections, determine annual project plans, and view data for the project team. This includes:Unit Name, Contact Number, Responsible Person, Associated Project, Annual Plan.Each unit contains multiple electrical grid infrastructure projects.
2.Business Project Department Module:
Manage project progress, including planning, summarizing, report reviews, etc., and report encountered issues.Records include:Project Department ID, Department Name, Responsible Person, Project Progress, and Issue Reporting.Each project department contains multiple electrical grid infrastructure projects.
3.Supervision Project Department Module:Display resources and management overview of the supervision department in a static web page format.Includes:Supervision Department Name, Responsible Person, Resource Allocation, Personnel Management.Each supervision department supervises multiple construction management units.
4.Electrical Grid Infrastructure Projects:Each electrical grid infrastructure project includes:
Project ID, Project Name, Construction Progress, Resource Allocation, Quality Control, Safety Management.
5.Resources:Manage and allocate resources such as human and material resources effectively to improve utilization and reduce costs.Records include:Resource Type, Resource Quantity.Each project can be assigned multiple resources, and each resource can be used by multiple projects. Resource allocation and usage records need to be kept.
6.Collaborative Work Platform:Supports task assignment, progress tracking, and feedback on completion status.Every task includes:Task Name, Responsible Person, Task Progress, Task Priority, Completion Status.Each task includes multiple electrical grid infrastructure projects.
nl_text: The rschema_0506 database is designed to manage various aspects of construction management, including project planning, resource allocation, and task tracking. The database consists of 11 tables that work together to provide a comprehensive view of the construction process. The construction_management_unit table stores information about individual construction management units, including their unit ID, name, contact number, responsible person, associated project, annual plan, and the ID of the supervision department they report to. The business_project_department_progress table tracks the progress of business projects, including the department name, responsible person, project progress, and issue reporting. The resource_allocation table manages resource allocation, linking resources to projects and tracking their allocation status and usage record. The collaborative_task table stores information about collaborative tasks, including the task ID, project ID, task name, responsible person, task progress, and task priority. The supervision_project_department table stores information about supervision departments, including their department ID, name, responsible person, resource allocation, and personnel management. The electrical_grid_infrastructure_project table tracks the progress of electrical grid infrastructure projects, including the project ID, name, construction progress, resource allocation, quality control, safety management, and the ID of the project department and construction management unit responsible. The resource_table stores information about available resources, including their ID, type, and quantity. The collaborative_work_platform table stores information about tasks on the collaborative work platform, including the task ID, name, responsible person, task progress, task priority, and completion status. The project_management table stores information about projects, including the project ID, unit ID, project name, construction progress, resource allocation, quality control, and safety management. The project_department_management table tracks the progress of project departments, including the project department ID, project ID, project name, project progress, and issue reporting. Finally, the supervision_department_management table stores information about supervision departments, including their department ID, project ID, project name, resource allocation, and personnel management.
